messages:
jeremy-cs: quick flag 6 OrpheusCare pilot overnight activity collapsed from ~78% -> 22%. Their nightly embedding pipeline paused. putting on renewal-watch.
nina-am: thanks. any alerting fired? hazel, were you in the enablement call last week?
hazel-csm: champion (Ravi) is out sick; Marta (procurement) took point and said they9re considering a cost-first vendor for embeddings. also raised data residency questions for EU patients.
leo-ml: triage notes: no infra OOMs. found increased 502s on /v1/embeds between 02:10-02:35 UTC. sample log:
```
2025-07-12T02:17:05Z ERROR embed-service: upstream grpc deadline exceeded for job batch-9832
```
leo-ml: also ran a quick model diff: v1.9 -> v2.0 embedding similarities drift ~3% on their test corpus.
ops-bot: incident-9832 created. Pager duty notified.
jeremy-cs: Marta said they paused to avoid noisy results and potential PHI concerns while legal reviews residency. can we offer a staging VPC / EU region pin as a stopgap?
nina-am: good idea. cost is the procurement focus; Marta asked for a clear bill estimate if we switch to eu-west region and if dedicated capacity is needed.
leo-ml: we can spin a private EU tenancy (Redwood Private) but lead time ~5 business days. Short-term: we can route their pilot traffic to our eu-west hosted region with residency controls. latency delta ~+40ms.
hazel-csm: i'll ask Marta whether latency +40ms is acceptable. also offering a short QA checklist and a one-hour assisted run to validate outputs before resuming nightly jobs.
marta-procurement: appreciate the fast triage. procurement needs: 1) cost delta eu vs us, 2) guarantee on no data egress, 3) a short remediation SLA if results are noisy. also can you confirm whether rollback to v1.9 is possible?
leo-ml: rollback/pin to v1.9 is immediate for routing. we'll prepare a short note on egress and encryption-in-transit+at-rest. SLA: propose 24h high-priority response for pilot issues.
jeremy-cs: proposing a temporary commercial gesture: 2-week pilot credit + assisted EU onboarding session if they resume runs and sign an intent form. nina, want to own the commercial note?
nina-am: can do. will draft an intent form + cost comparison for eu-hosted vs dedicated. hold commercial offer until we confirm embedding stability after routing change.
ops-bot: routing-change-2042 applied: OrpheusCare pilot routed to eu-west hosted region (canary). health checks running.
leo-ml: canary checks OK on 50-case sample of their prompts; embedding similarity back within 1% of baseline. no PHI logged in traces (redacted).
hazel-csm: shared quick checklist with Marta and scheduled a 30-min assisted QA in 90m.
marta-procurement: thanks, scheduled. if QA looks good we'll resume nightly batches and I'll share procurement timeline (internal RFP wraps in 10 days).
jeremy-cs: setting renewal-watch and pairing CSM+AM. if procurement still signals vendor shift after QA, escalate to sales for a tailored dedicated offering + migration support. :thumbsup:"
